note: Bighorn NF campground in lodgepole pine beside the South Tongue River, 4.7 mi off US 14 (Bighorn Scenic Byway) on FSR 26, about 45 mi W of Dayton. Two back-in loops; run by a concessionaire. OHV trails in the surrounding forest. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov 234221: 20 back-in sites (17 reservable, 005-007 FCFS), RV lengths 35-60 ft, no hookups, vault toilets + drinking water, Memorial Day-Labor Day (2027 rate season Jun 11-Sep 5), 14-day limit. Fee: rec.gov $20.50 (2026 and 2027) vs FS page $23. Waterfront: the South Tongue is ~7-11 m wide here (creek-size); site 15 sits ~10-20 m from the channel, 13/14/16 20-50 m behind trees -> riverview kept, creekside is arguable on site 15 alone.
flags: WATERFRONT (keep riverview; reviewer may consider creekside): the South Tongue River channel is ~7-11 m wide at the campground (creek-size, so any on-water value would be creekside, not riverfront). rec.gov tags 013, 014, 015, 016 'Riverfront'. On Esri imagery: 015 (44.69030,-107.44444) is ~10-20 m from the channel with only scattered conifers between - clearly on the water; 014 (44.69059,-107.44578) ~20 m and 013 (44.69060,-107.44618) ~30 m from the channel through a band of conifers; 016 (44.68968,-107.44466) ~45 m through trees and willow. One clearly waterfront site out of 20 is short of 'a few', so riverview stays; creekside naming site 015 is the alternative.
FEE CONFLICT: FS page 'Single Site: $23 per night' vs recreation.gov rate table $20.50 for 2026 and 2027 seasons; rec.gov written (it is what booking charges).

Missing phone: empty -> 307-674-2600 (Bighorn NF Supervisor's / Tongue Ranger District, FS page). The concessionaire is Rustic Freedom / Gallatin Canyon Campgrounds, 307-431-7446 (rec.gov overview; rec.gov facility phone 406-587-9054).
OHV: the FS page lists 'OHV Trail Riding' and rec.gov 'Off-road vehicle trails ... in the surrounding area' - a general campground with an OHV side, not a staging camp (flag only).
